q: A covering space p: (X̃, x̃₀) → (X, x₀) corresponds (via the monodromy action) to:
opts: A normal subgroup of π₁(X, x₀)
A subgroup H ≤ π₁(X, x₀) (namely p_*(π₁(X̃, x̃₀)))
exp: Covering space theory: connected covering spaces of X correspond (up to isomorphism) to conjugacy classes of subgroups of π₁(X). The subgroup is the image p_*(π₁(X̃)). The universal cover corresponds to the trivial subgroup.
